build_MultinomialRaysampler: build a ray sampler that samples points along rays from a rectangular image grid with configurable depth range
build_NDCMultinomialRaysampler: build a ray sampler using PyTorch3D NDC screen conventions for sampling rays from an image grid
build_MonteCarloRaysampler: build a ray sampler that randomly selects real-valued pixel locations and emits rays from them
test_safe_multinomial: test the safe multinomial sampling wrapper that falls back to sampling with replacement when needed
test_jiggle_within_stratas: test the stratified sampling function that jiggles bin centers within their intervals
